translations.web: TEKEL: you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.
translations.bsb: TEKEL means that you have been weighed on the scales and found deficient.
translations.kjv: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
translations.asv: TEKEL; thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
